book.name: Nen Galati Mo
book.title: Lepran Ɗe Pool Ran Nen Galati Mo

content: Katpee Ɗe Mun Kǝ Nǝ nƊǝǝn Kristi

Mbii ɗe nǝ le, ɗangɓe Kristi wur pwat kǝ mun ndǝr Wàar kǝ nen Yahudi nǝ mo, a mbǝkǝ mun ɗee ɗi a nankáa sun azeen-nzeen. Mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe wen kǝn sat nwun nee, wu ɗar ɓalɓal kaa nen ɗe mo a nankáa sut sǝ. Taji wu baa wu shìn káa fuu, mbǝkǝ wu baa wu ɗee ɗi a kǝrem kas.
Wen Pool, an nkaa sat nǝ wun nee, katɗang wu yit mmee gurum can wun, ɓe nǝ ɗee agaak nǝnee, << mbii ɗe Kristi kǝ cìn mbǝ wun, ɓe nǝ ɗee a buu mǝnǝ.
Wen kǝn rǝɓet kǝ koo a weyi man azeen-nzeen nǝ, katɗang mee gurum waa rǝɓet kǝ mo can wur, ɓe nǝ ɗee a tǝng kǝ wur gam koor wàar nǝ mo ɗi jir.
Wun nen ɗe wu pan nee, wuu ɗee a ɗe ndǝre nyit Naan, mbǝɗe wuu tap kǝ wàar nǝ mo, ɓe wu pwat kǝ káa fuu mo aku nɗǝǝn Kristi. Wuu ɗee a ɗepǝpal nɗǝǝn ɗeret ɗe Kristi kǝ ten cìn mo mbǝ wun.
Ɗangɓe mun nen ɗe baa mu leyit a nkaa can kas, ɓe nɗǝǝn Riin shi shinzeen ɓe, muu tong a shi gongpee shi canciin mǝ ɗe ndǝre mǝ Naan.
Katɗang mu ɗee a ɗemǝndong kǝ Kristi Jesu, ɓe baa nǝ kuɗi mee koop nǝ kas, koo ɗe mo can gurum, kǝ koo ɗe baa mo can gurum kas, ɗangɓe mbii ɗe nǝ kǝkoop nǝ a shinzeen ɗe nǝ kám sat nɗǝǝn wal.
Dǝ nyam, ɓe wun nkaa sekyeen nɗǝǝn pwoo ɗeret nǝ hakyeng, ɗangɓe yaksǝ, ɓe a me le ɗang baa wu kuɗi wuu mwaan nɗǝǝn zeen nǝ kas yi?
Baa a Naan ɗewur pǝrep wun, a wur cíi sekyeen nwun kas.
<<A rep yist lee nǝ le kǝ bred wup ɗi.>>
Ɗang mbǝɗe mun a ɗemǝndong nɗǝǝn Daa fun, ɓe an shinzeen nee, baa pan fuu mo waa ɗen ɗyik kǝ mǝnǝ kas. Wen shinzeen nee, ngwe ɗewur nǝk wun sǝ, koo ɗewur a wii, ɓe Naan nshín kar wur.

Ɗang ɗyemnaa mo, katɗang an kǝn sat an satpwoo nǝ, can nǝ a tǝng, ɓe a me le ɗang ghan kǝn sat a nshwaajeel ɗak yi? Katɗang nǝ aasǝ, ɓe moo shang mbii ɗe nǝ le canshii ngurum mo nɗǝǝn shiyeepyoom Kristi.
Nen ɗe mo daampee nookɗi nwun sǝ, wen fes nrǝɓet kǝ mo dǝm pun sut kǝ mo ɗee ɗi a meermuut mo.

Ɗyemnaa mo, Naan wur pǝrep wun, mbǝkǝ taji wu ɗee a kǝrem mo ndǝr wàar mǝ nen Yahudi mo kas, ɗangɓe, taji wu le kǝ katpee fuu nǝ, nǝ ɗee a ar ɗe wun ncìn mbii ɗebish mǝ nan ɗi kas. Ɗangɓe nǝ ret kǝ wu walnshak kǝ ɓamshak zak.
Mo gam wàar nǝ mo jir a nɗǝǝn pwoo ɗesǝ nǝnee, <<A wal ngǝnang fwaa kaa sak sǝ.>>
Katɗang wun nɗee a kaa luwaayil ɗe moo seshak sǝ, ɓe wu tap taji wu tu shak kyes kǝdǝng-ndǝng.
Wu Tong nƊǝǝn Riin Naan
Wen kǝn sat nwun nee, wu mwaan nɗǝǝn Riin, mbǝkǝ taji wu gam ɗyen mǝ nan nǝ kas.

Mbǝɗe mbii ɗenan nǝ kǝ rǝɓet, ɓe baa mo a nciit kǝ mbii ɗe Riin nǝ rǝɓet kas. Kǝzak, mbii ɗe Riin nǝ rǝɓet ɓe baa mo a nciit kǝ mbii ɗenan nǝ rǝɓet kas. Mbii ɗevǝl sǝ mo baa moo rǝɓet shak kas. Ɗesǝ nǝ ɗee nee baa wu mak cìn mbii ɗe wuu rǝɓet kas.
Ɗang katɗang wuu mwaan a nɗǝǝn Riin Naan, ɓe baa wu kuɗi a ndǝr Wàar nǝ kas.
Ɗak ɗe gurum moo cìn nɗǝǝn mǝse kǝ gurum, nǝ agaak. Kyeet kǝ ɗak mǝnǝ mo, a kaa cin ngaa, ɗak ɗebish mo, cìn mbii ɗebish nen yitlwaan.
Seyil nkùm, ɗak soot, ciishak, jǝǝr, zuur, tuup, rǝɓetkáa, ɓákshak, mǝse ɗe nǝ a mǝ yilangpee.

Zuur ɗebish, shwaayuur, kuur ashak ɗebish mo, kǝ mbii ɗebish mo ɗe shini-shinǝ. Wen kǝn satpwoo nwun shiɓal, kaaɗe gyet ghan kǝn sat nwun sǝ nǝ, nen ɗe moo cìn mbii ɗesǝ mo jir, ɓe baa mon ncam ɗel nɗǝǝn mulki Naan kas, koo dǝɓen.
Ɗang ɗak ɗe gurum moo cìn nɗǝǝn Riin Naan mo a, walnshak, kǝ retnyit, tongryang, gung mbii mo, naajeel nshak, cìn mbii ɗeret mo, shinzeen,
sham kǝ káa, yaasuk. Mbii ɗesǝ mo jir, baa mee Wàar ɗe nkaa mo kas.
Nen ɗe mo a mǝ Kristi Jesu, mo kǝ ten pwas nan fur mo nkaa shiyeep ashak kǝ koor nǝ.
Katɗang mu tong a nɗǝǝn Riin, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ mu mwaan nɗǝǝn Riin nǝ zak.
Taji mu ɗiyeepkáa kas, kǝ taji mu le tuup nshak kas. Taji mu cìn zuur kǝ shak kas zak.
